listing.name: Poseidon: Master of Atlantis (eZeus)
listing.summary: Prepare Poseidon: Master of Atlantis through its upstream player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use the matching original game
steps.instruction: Both Zeus: Master of Olympus and the Poseidon expansion original files are required, including for the base-game identity. Upstream currently supports English and Polish. Preserve the original installation and work in a separate complete copy; eZeus differs from the original and does not promise exact parity.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the player
steps.instruction: Prepare the full eZeus-0.8.2-beta.zip from its base release, then the later eZeus-0.8.2-beta.4.exe patch. The patch EXE alone is not a complete package. Follow the base release instructions: extract the eZeus folder under your working Zeus and Poseidon folder, perform upstream text conversion of Zeus_Text.eng and Zeus_MM.eng to the corresponding XML files, and place them where upstream specifies. Apply the patch player in the eZeus Bin folder, retaining all base resources. Register Bin/eZeus-0.8.2-beta.4.exe with Bin as working directory. engconverter-0.5.exe and VC_redist.x64.exe are preparation helpers, not players; run prerequisites deliberately only when needed.

steps.title: Preserve the actual player data
steps.instruction: The player normally finds originals two directories above its EXE, or through zeus_path.txt. The eZeus root above Bin owns settings.txt, Save and companion resources such as Textures/Adventures. Preserve the entire working originals and eZeus tree, including any explicit original path, before replacing upstream files. No old-save conversion or base/expansion compatibility is inferred.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream preparation before registration. Register the real player with its matching working directory and separate literal argument lines. Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this runtime, original files, saves and configuration. Registration-only removal preserves these external files; managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are unavailable for them. Preserve the working runtime and every actual data/profile location with the game closed before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own upstream flow.

warnings: The latest release supplies a patch player, not a standalone game. Complete upstream preparation is required; managed setup and native gameplay remain unqualified.
